question: The state government of ________ launched the Technology Transfer Scheme in November 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** Technology Transfer Scheme** is a state government initiative aimed at promoting **technology transfer** from research institutions to the industry.
 
• Kerala launched this scheme in **November 2022** to boost** innovation and entrepreneurship **in the state.
 
• Kerala is known for its focus on** education and technology**, with several top-ranked institutes of **higher education and research centers** located in the state.
